# IndexFast

> SEO indexing automation and diagnostics. Find indexing issues. Ship fixes faster.
> Discover → Diagnose → Submit: sitemap monitoring, indexing-blocker diagnosis
> (noindex, canonical, redirects, HTTP errors), and IndexNow + Bing submission.

IndexFast does not guarantee Google indexing. It speeds up discovery of new and
updated URLs and finds the blockers that keep pages out of the index.

## Product

- [IndexFast](https://indexfast.co/): SEO indexing automation and diagnostics.
- [Free SEO tools](https://indexfast.co/tools): 11 free tools including Google Index
  Checker, Bulk Index Checker, Sitemap Extractor, Robots.txt Checker, Canonical
  Checker, Noindex Checker, IndexNow Key Generator, llms.txt Generator, and
  AI Crawler Checker.
- [MCP endpoint](https://indexfast.co/api/mcp): live product MCP (JSON).
- [Resources](https://indexfast.co/resources/directories): guides and directories,
  including posts on programmatic SEO, IndexNow, and Google Search Console alerts.

## Pricing

- Free ($0): 1 site, 500 URLs, daily sitemap check, IndexNow auto-submit,
  MCP + API access, no credit card required.
- Pro ($19/month): 10 sites, 10,000 URLs per site, 20,000 API calls, hourly checks.
- Unlimited ($99/month): unlimited sites and unlimited API calls.
- All plans are prepaid for 30 days with no auto-renew.
- The FAQ is explicit: IndexFast cannot guarantee Google indexing — it accelerates
  discovery and surfaces blockers.

## Who it's for

- Programmatic SEO operators monitoring large sitemaps for indexing gaps.
- Directory and database-site builders who publish pages at scale.
- Indie hackers and portfolio builders who want new pages discovered faster.
- SEO agencies and publishers managing many client or editorial URLs.
- E-commerce, marketplace, B2B SaaS, and devtool teams with high URL churn.

## Company

- IndexFast is listed on AlternativeTo and G2 as a Google Search Console /
  SimilarWeb alternative.
- Contact for sales and support via the website. Replies are handled from the
  founder's inbox.
